messages:
ava: Draft ready — pushing the product launch blog into review. doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1-Rdwx (editable)
jonah: Looks good at a glance. I'll do a copy pass this afternoon. Can we tighten the benchmark claims?
priya: Need to confirm the benchmark context (query mix / seq len). Marco, did we run the 99th pct latency across the same QPS baseline as the public benchmark? @marco
marco: Yes — same QPS profile, 512 token max, mixed prompt distribution (30% long, 70% short). Numbers in the draft are from the infra run on 2026-03-10. I can paste the raw numbers.
ava: pls paste them here and I'll inline a short methods note. Also need final CTA and webinar date. Prefer Wed 3/25 for the webinar — works for product and me.
jonah: For claims: change "3x faster" -> "~3x faster on common website prompts (median)" — avoids overclaiming. Also propose adding a small chart screenshot.
priya: Agreed. Also add which model variants were used (quantized vs fp16) — buyers care.
marco: Added note: 'Benchmark run: Redwood-Serve v2.1 on A100s; model: open-model-7b-q4; sequence max=512; workload: internal common website prompts mix; median latency measured at steady-state QPS 120.'
samira: On webinar — I need the lead routing mapping. Can we auto-tag registrants in HubSpot with: source=launch_blog, webinar=3/25, priority=high if company_size>500? Example rule:
```
if registrant.company_size > 500 then set lead.priority = "high"
if registrant.source contains "launch_blog" then add workflow = "webinar_followup"
```
legal-bot: Quick heads up — marketing claims flagged for review: the phrase "industry-best" is not allowed. Recommend replacing with "among the fastest we've measured". Also check the data retention line for the webinar recording (add opt-out link).
ava: Good catch. I'll remove "industry-best". Jonah — can you swap that phrasing and shorten the hero paragraph to 2 sentences?
jonah: Yep. I'll do a lightweight rewrite and attach a screenshot of the latency chart. ETA 2pm PT.
priya: For signoff flow: who needs to approve before publish? I'm thinking: Content (jonah) -> Product (marco) -> Legal (legal-bot / legal ops) -> Growth (samira) -> Ava final publish.
marco: I'm good to sign once Jonah updates the phrasing and I verify the methods blurb.
samira: Growth will want the UTM matrix too. Ava, can you add default UTMs so our HubSpot capture works?
ava: Will add UTMs. Proposed utm_source=redwood_blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_2026_3_25
jonah: copy edit done. Replaced "industry-best" with "among the fastest we've measured" and trimmed the hero. Pasted chart: https://imgur.com/a/abc123
marco: Verified the methods note and numbers match the infra run logs. ✅
legal-bot: Legal review complete — two minor asks: add opt-out link for webinar recording and remove a comparative claim about competitor X (we can't assert that without a public head-to-head). Both are minor.
ava: I'll remove competitor mention and add opt-out line. Samira — once UTMs + HubSpot routing rules are in place, can you confirm the workflow ID we'll use?
samira: Workflow ID is 8923-prod-webinar-followup. I'll hook the form to that and set the lead scoring rule. Also setting a notify@reps alias for high priority leads.
ava: Final checklist before publish:
- [ ] Copy edits (jonah) — done
- [ ] Methods note (marco) — done
- [ ] Legal tweaks (legal-bot) — done
- [ ] UTMs + HubSpot routing (ava + samira) — in progress
- [ ] Hero chart screenshot — attached by jonah
- [ ] Schedule publish + embargo time — we pick Tue 3/24 10:00am PT publish, webinar Wed 3/25 11:00am PT
priya: Tue publish is fine. Also schedule the social posts and the webinar CTA on the blog template.
ava: tagging final approvals — @marco, @samira, @legal-bot. If I don't hear objections by EOD Monday (1768698745), I'll lock and schedule.
marco: No objections.
samira: All good from Growth.
legal-bot: No further comments.
ava: Great — locking draft and scheduling. Thanks everyone! :tada:
